A bag contains 5 red, 8 white and 7 black balls. A ball is drawn at random. Find the probability that it is not black.
Prove that √5 is irrational.

markingScheme.step: Assume √5 = p/q with p, q coprime; get p² = 5q²
Show 5 divides p, then 5 divides q
Contradiction with coprime, so √5 is irrational

questions.solution: Let √5 = p/q (coprime). Then p² = 5q², so 5 | p; write p = 5k: 25k² = 5q², q² = 5k², so 5 | q. This contradicts p, q coprime. Hence √5 is irrational.

questions.text: Prove that (sin θ − cos θ + 1)/(sin θ + cos θ − 1) = 1/(sec θ − tan θ).

markingScheme.step: Divide numerator and denominator by cos θ: (tan θ − 1 + sec θ)/(tan θ + 1 − sec θ)
Replace 1 by sec²θ − tan²θ and factor (sec θ + tan θ)
Simplify to sec θ + tan θ = 1/(sec θ − tan θ)

questions.solution: LHS = (tan θ + sec θ − 1)/(tan θ − sec θ + 1). Write 1 = sec²θ − tan²θ in the numerator: (tan θ + sec θ) − (sec θ − tan θ)(sec θ + tan θ) = (sec θ + tan θ)(1 − sec θ + tan θ). Dividing by the denominator gives sec θ + tan θ = 1/(sec θ − tan θ).

questions.text: From the top of a 7 m high building, the angle of elevation of the top of a cable tower is 60° and the angle of depression of its foot is 45°. Find the height of the tower.

markingScheme.step: tan 60° = h/7 gives h = 7√3 m above the building's top

questions.solution: Distance between the buildings = 7 m (tan 45° = 1). The extra height above the building = 7 tan 60° = 7√3. Tower height = 7(1 + √3) ≈ 19.12 m.

questions.text: A solid toy is in the form of a hemisphere surmounted by a right circular cone. The height of the cone is 2 cm and the diameter of the base is 4 cm. Find the volume of the toy (π = 3.14).
questions.solution: r = 2 cm. Cone = 8π/3, hemisphere = 16π/3, total = 8π = 25.12 cm³.

questions.topic: Case study: tangents to a circular park
questions.text: Case study: A circular park has a fountain at its centre O and radius 10 m. From a gate P, 26 m from O, two straight paths PA and PB touch the park boundary at A and B. (i) Find the length of path PA. [1] (ii) Find ∠OAP. [1] (iii) Find the area of the quadrilateral OAPB. [2]
questions.solution: (i) 24 m. (ii) 90°. (iii) ΔOAP ≅ ΔOBP, each of area 120 m², so the quadrilateral is 240 m².
